items.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
items.summary: RL post‑training enhances diffusion transformers’ visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy by learning input‑dependent transformations.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers care because it boosts AI image generation fidelity and prompt reliability, key for creative and industrial applications.

items.title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
items.summary: PlayCraft automates game design by using a vision-based AI agent’s play experience to refine games for mastery and engagement.
items.whyItMatters: It speeds up creating engaging games, saving designers time and improving player retention.

items.title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
items.summary: TideCache is a CPU–GPU hybrid LLM serving system that allocates GPU memory and manages cache residency across GPU and host memory for efficient layer-wise streaming.
items.whyItMatters: It boosts LLM inference speed and resource utilization, appealing to tech-savvy users seeking high-performance AI deployments.

items.title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
items.summary: The paper proposes O^2LaF, using a pretrained video diffusion transformer as a prior to learn both inverse and forward latent action dynamics from visual transitions.
items.whyItMatters: It could accelerate self-supervised action learning by leveraging powerful generative priors, saving training time and improving sample efficiency.

items.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
items.summary: The paper analyzes how frontier multimodal agents like GPT-6 Astra control robots at the action level, revealing success patterns and failure points.
items.whyItMatters: It helps engineers refine robot‑control models and improve safety and reliability in real‑world deployments.

items.title: Bio-PM-Guided Synthetic IMU Generation
items.summary: The paper proposes a bio‑PM‑guided method to synthesize IMU data, improving human activity recognition models by augmenting limited real datasets.
items.whyItMatters: Tech‑savvy readers care because synthetic data can reduce labeling costs and boost model robustness across users.

items.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
items.summary: Depth Pro 2 estimates dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution, balancing temporal consistency and boundary sharpness in a single scalable network.
items.whyItMatters: It offers sharper, temporally stable depth maps, improving AR/VR and autonomous perception tasks.

items.title: SoK: Assessing the Evolution of LLM Capability in Software Vulnerability Research
items.summary: The paper presents a framework to evaluate how large language models help discover, validate, and patch software vulnerabilities, highlighting their growing impact.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers should know LLMs are reshaping vulnerability detection and remediation, affecting security practices and tool development.

items.title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
items.summary: The paper proposes a method for Active Feature Acquisition that distills knowledge from an oracle teacher to train a cost-aware feature selection policy.
items.whyItMatters: It offers a more efficient way to reduce data acquisition costs while maintaining model performance.

items.title: PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.summary: PGX offloads temporal and precision control to classical methods, enabling VLA models to handle long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation tasks.
items.whyItMatters: It improves efficiency and reliability of complex robotic tasks without retraining deep models.

items.title: Realized versus Population Reliability: Anytime-Valid Self-Consistency Certification under Correlated Reasoning
items.summary: The paper shows that language model rollouts are correlated, invalidating prior independence assumptions in self‑consistency certification, and proposes a corrected anytime‑valid method.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers need reliable error control for AI reasoning, especially when models generate dependent outputs.

items.title: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
items.summary: The paper introduces MC‑Lens, a multimodal Jacobian tool to probe internal concept representations in vision‑language models using Global Workspace Theory.
items.whyItMatters: It offers a new way to interpret and debug multimodal AI, aiding developers in understanding model behavior.

items.title: Verify the Verifier: Specification-Grounded LLM Cross-Checking for Bugs That Escape UVM Scoreboards
items.summary: A passing UVM regression shows the design agrees with the reference model on what the scoreboard checks, not that it meets the specification. Bugs that pass every test yet violate the specification, termed scoreboard escapes, survive mature testbenches. We present Verify the Verifier, to our knowledge the first framework whose LLM-based Anomaly Cross-Checker examines a passing regression's traces…

items.title: ProtoDiffusion: Token-per-Layer Generative Modeling of Multi-Layer Images
items.summary: Graphic designs are ordered compositions of RGBA layers whose separation enables selection, movement, and reuse. Existing layered models represent each layer with a full-canvas or region-sized spatial latent grid, so representation size grows with the cumulative spatial extent of the layers. We present ProtoDiffusion, a latent-diffusion framework built on ProtoVAE, a multi-layer variational…

items.title: Represented but misread: Post-training changes how language models read out what they represent
items.summary: Does post-training change what a language model represents, or how this representation is read out into an answer? We compared linear probes with the models' own answers, analyzed with signal detection theory, in six open-weight base models and their post-trained versions. items.title: Text-Aware, Vision-Blind: How Multimodal Image Editing Systems Handle Unsafe Inputs
items.summary: Multimodal image generation systems have made rapid progress and increasingly emphasize content safety. However, their safety mechanisms tend to rely on a single modality and lack joint consideration of both visual content and text prompts, particularly in instruction-guided image editing, where the uploaded image may itself carry risk. We thus introduce EditSafetyBench, a benchmark that measures…

items.title: GEOHunter: Mapping a Generative Engine Optimization Network in the Wild
items.summary: Generative engines synthesize retrieved web pages into answers, recommendations, and rankings. Generative engine optimization (GEO) services sell visibility in these answers by publishing promotional articles on user-generated-content (UGC) platforms for paying clients. Such promotion raises concerns in medical and financial domains, where misleading advice can cause harm. To study the severity…

items.title: Multi-institutional grading of Barrett's esophagus dysplasia without stain normalization using a pathology foundation model and multiple instance learning
items.summary: Barrett's esophagus dysplasia grading suffers substantial inter-observer variability, particularly for low-grade dysplasia, complicating clinical decision-making. We conducted a retrospective multi-institutional diagnostic accuracy study of a foundation model-based deep learning system for dysplasia grading, using 969 H\&E-stained whole slide images from four institutions. Patch-level classifiers…

items.title: MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
items.summary: When multimodal decision models determine actions, moderation outcomes, or quality judgments, their reliability depends on preserving semantic decisions across presentation changes, ignoring irrelevant additions, and distinguishing information consistent with task evidence from information that conflicts with it. Existing evaluations study decision-interface biases and multimodal model behavior…

items.title: Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation (ROGUE-AI)
items.summary: Agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now delete files and send payments on behalf of their users. News media reports routinely describe failures of these agents (e.g., Replit's coding agent deleting a production database), but a report often only says what went wrong and rarely (in)validates the incident or finds its root cause.
